purpose: Operational coverage accountability from retained inventories and accepted receipts; not a new corpus audit, applicability determination or current-law certification. A later reviewed_on within a family row updates that row only, not all baseline measurements.

status_meanings.complete_publisher_edition: The explicitly named publisher export inventory is closed. This may be an older edition, a narrowed compilation or raw files with projection exclusions; it does not establish a complete current legal layer.
status_meanings.partial: Some accepted body material is retained, but the named legal family or inventory is incomplete.
status_meanings.acquired_but_unverified: Acquired material exists but the stronger edition claim specified in the row has not been verified.
status_meanings.blocked: Recorded access/policy failures prevented the scoped source acquisition; this is not proof every possible publisher is inaccessible.
status_meanings.absent: No accepted body material for this family is evidenced here; an inventory lead alone is not body coverage.

count_semantics: Inventory units are named per row. Null means unknown, not zero. Excluded counts describe the stated inventory only, never all omitted law. Raw-file retention is not synonymous with searchable-text fidelity.
layer_complete_meaning: True would require verified complete current coverage of the entire named legal layer, beyond an individual publisher compilation. No row makes that claim; false means not established, not necessarily zero source coverage.
shared_exclusions: No blanket completeness of uncodified/session law, later amendments, historical editions, incorporated external standards, case law or legally operative effectiveness.
Constitution, court-rule, guidance, proposed-rule and metadata-only records do not substitute for statewide statutes or administrative regulations.
Unknown precise snapshot dates remain unknown. Observation, incorporation, publication and effective dates are distinct.
Acceptance verifies a scoped projection; provenance-only replay support is not an unaccepted-source label. No redistribution permission is inferred.

evidence_conventions.paths: Project-relative paths. Each row's evidence locates its accepted family scope; absence is checked against the accepted collection inventory, not inferred from a source name.
evidence_conventions.accepted_manifest_hashes: replay/catalog.json#/batches: match acceptance_manifest.path; its sha256 identifies the exact accepted manifest, not a prior/rejected review.
evidence_conventions.manifest_fields: completeness_review, reviewed_accounting, clock_review and evidence_sha256; source-family inventory totals are also in docs/collection-wave.json collection_units selected by collection id.
evidence_conventions.current_inventory: data/legal.sqlite3: inventories WHERE collection_id=<exact collection id>; collection metadata retains source inventory artifact and clock evidence.
evidence_conventions.limits: Baseline legal classifications reuse existing acceptance reviews, not a new whole-corpus certification. Portland/Oregon completion receipts update those scopes separately. Population uses separately retained and reconciled Census CSVs; it does not certify legal completeness.

population.denominator_scope: 50 states plus DC; national SUMLEV010 equals 51 non-PR SUMLEV040 rows. Regions and Puerto Rico excluded from sums.
population.semantics: Population living in a source jurisdiction, not laws per person or a legal-applicability finding. Each entity is counted once within a layer; never add layers or overlapping geography. Closed publisher inventories may be old/narrowed or have projection exclusions.
population.identity_basis: Exact retained Census STATEFP/STUSPS crosswalk and whole-place GEOIDs 3651000/4159000. July estimates and January geometry are separate vintages; no overlay population is inferred.

fully_verified_combined_coverage.reason: No complete combined current statute, administrative-regulation and local-law layer has been verified. Publisher-edition statuses must not be added together or population-weighted as if they established that claim.
